Summary

Established over 50 years ago, offering more than 1,500 natural products sourced globally. Specializes in organic herbs, spices, teas, essential oils, and herbal extracts. Committed to USDA National Organic Program standards and sustainable direct-farmer partnerships. Their product range includes cut/sifted herbs and powders, loose leaf and tea bags, essential and carrier oils, liquid extracts and standardized powders, seasoning blends and gourmet salts, and specialty items like sprouting seeds and bath & body products. Based in Rocklin, California.
